title: oenothera runcinata
intro: Oenothera runcinata, commonly known as Cut-leaved Evening Primrose, is a plant species within the Onagraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera runcinata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as isoflavones and phenolic acids, which exhibit estrogenic activity and may have a protective effect on cardiovascular health. Further research is needed to confirm the full range of bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
